description: Reads effective supplier settings after store defaults and supplier overrides. This is settings data, not supplier availability or listing usage data. Boolean monitoring settings do not enable or disable a supplier. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
